features.title: What the app does
features.intro: Straight from the App Store and Google Play listings. No drama, just the facts.

items.title: Identify from a photo
items.text: Snap a leaf, a flower, a fruit or the whole plant and get its name in seconds.

items.title: Health check
items.text: Photograph the trouble spot. See the likely causes, what to do and how to prevent it next time.

items.title: Ask the AI expert
items.text: Chat with an AI expert about care, pests or any plant question.

items.title: Your plant collection
items.text: Save every plant you identify, with its care tips in one place.

items.title: Care reminders
items.text: Reminders for each plant, so you never forget to look after it.

items.title: Handy tools
items.text: A light meter to find the right spot, and a watering helper.

features.platform_title: A few extras depend on your phone
ios_items: Identify trees in winter from their bark and buds
Tree age and tree height tools
An encyclopedia of 160 trees and shrubs
features.premium_note: Unlimited identification and the advanced features need Premium, a paid subscription. Details in the FAQ.
features.ai_note: Results come from an AI analysis of your photos and are indicative. Never eat a plant on the word of an app alone.

items.a: Tree Identifier is free to download. Unlimited identification and the advanced features are part of Premium, a paid subscription. The price is shown in the app before you subscribe, and you can cancel anytime in your App Store or Google Play account settings.

On iPhone: trees, shrubs, palms, conifers and fruit trees. You can photograph a leaf, the bark, a flower, a fruit or the whole tree, and bark and buds work in winter too. On Android: flowers, trees, leaves, fruits, houseplants and garden weeds.

items.q: Is the toxicity info veterinary or medical advice?
items.a: No. It's general information with sources. If you think a pet or a child ate a plant, contact a vet or a poison control center right away.
